# Third-Party Realtime Market Data API

- Source Swagger: `docs/swagger/third-party/swagger.json`
- API title: `Toktik Options Platform API`
- API version: `1.0`

## Scope

This document exports realtime and near-realtime third-party provider endpoints. It includes Polygon-backed US stock and US option endpoints plus the Deribit crypto option-chain endpoint. It intentionally excludes database-backed market, analytics, and backtest APIs.

## Authentication

The API server authenticates requests with an API key in the `X-API-Key` HTTP header. Create a key with `go run ./cmd/api-keys create --name <name>`; the command prints the plaintext `api_key` once, so store it securely and do not commit it. Send the same value with every request to protected endpoints, for example:

```bash
curl -H 'X-API-Key: <api_key>' http://localhost:9010/api/v1/infra/markets
```

The server hashes the supplied key and accepts it only when the matching database record is active and not expired. Missing or invalid keys return `401 Unauthorized`; an authenticator/database failure returns `500`. The API key is not sent as a query parameter or as a bearer token. The stock logo utility at `/utils/us-stocks/logos/{symbol}` is public. Local-client bypass is available only when `api.bypass_auth_for_local_clients` (or `TOKTIK_BYPASS_AUTH_FOR_LOCAL_CLIENTS`) is explicitly enabled; it is disabled by default.

## Polygon Realtime Market Data

### US stock snapshot

- Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/polygon/stocks/snapshot`
- Tags: `Polygon`
- Produces: `application/json`
- Summary: Get realtime US stock snapshot via Polygon
- Description: Proxies Polygon stock snapshot data. This endpoint bypasses the platform database and is intended for realtime client reads.

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ticker | query | string | yes | Stock ticker symbol (alias: symbol) |

#### Responses

| Status | Schema | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | [PolygonStockSnapshotResponse](#polygonstocksnapshotresponse) | OK |
| 400 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Bad Request |
| 500 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Internal Server Error |

### US stock aggregates

- Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/polygon/stocks/aggregates`
- Tags: `Polygon`
- Produces: `application/json`
- Summary: Get US stock aggregate bars via Polygon
- Description: Proxies Polygon aggregate bars for historical or near-realtime stock data with short-TTL caching based on the requested time window.

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ticker | query | string | yes | Stock ticker symbol |
| multiplier | query | integer | no | Aggregate multiplier |
| timespan | query | string | yes | Timespan (minute,hour,day,...) |
| from | query | string | yes | Start time (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| to | query | string | yes | End time (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD) |
| adjusted | query | boolean | no | Adjusted results |
| sort | query | string | no | Sort direction |
| limit | query | integer | no | Page size |

#### Responses

| Status | Schema | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | [PolygonAggregateResponse](#polygonaggregateresponse) | OK |
| 400 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Bad Request |
| 500 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Internal Server Error |

## Deribit Realtime Market Data

### Crypto option chain snapshot

- Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/deribit/options/chain`
- Tags: `Deribit`
- Produces: `application/json`
- Summary: Get realtime crypto option chain snapshot via Deribit
- Description: Returns a realtime Deribit option chain. Option premium prices use the native premium currency; implied volatility is returned as a decimal.

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| underlying | query | string | yes | Underlying currency (for example BTC or ETH) |
| expiration_date | query | string | no | Exact expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| expiration_date_gte | query | string | no | Minimum expiration date |
| expiration_date_gt | query | string | no | Expiration date greater than |
| expiration_date_lte | query | string | no | Maximum expiration date |
| expiration_date_lt | query | string | no | Expiration date less than |
| contract_type | query | string | no | call or put |
| strike_price | query | number | no | Exact strike price |
| strike_price_gte | query | number | no | Minimum strike price |
| strike_price_gt | query | number | no | Strike price greater than |
| strike_price_lte | query | number | no | Maximum strike price |
| strike_price_lt | query | number | no | Strike price less than |
| order | query | string | no | Sort direction (asc or desc) |
| sort | query | string | no | Sort field |
| limit | query | integer | no | Maximum contracts (max 1000; zero returns all) |

#### Responses

| Status | Schema | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | [DeribitOptionChainResponse](#deribitoptionchainresponse) | OK |
| 400 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Bad Request |
| 501 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Not Implemented |
| 502 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Bad Gateway |
| 504 | [ErrorResponse](#errorresponse) | Gateway Timeout |
